name: Robert Sammelin
description: Robert Sammelin is a self-taught Swedish artist known for his dynamic work as an illustrator, graphic designer, and comic book creator. He’s contributed to book, magazine, and album covers, and is especially recognized for his concept art in the video game industry. Since 2007, he’s been a Senior Concept Artist at DICE, shaping the visual identity of the Battlefield series and other major titles. He lives and works in Stockholm.
